transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you to the clinic today?
Honestly, I've just been feeling really down and depressed for about ten months now. I've completely lost interest in doing anything I used to enjoy, and nothing seems to matter to me anymore.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during these ten months when you felt back to your usual self, or has it been present most days the whole time?
No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. It has been present pretty much every single day for the entire ten months. I haven't felt like my usual self even for a short time.
Along with feeling depressed, have you also had low energy, changes in sleep or appetite, poor concentration, low self-esteem, or feelings of hopelessness?

Yes, I've been struggling a lot with my concentration, and I find it really hard to focus on conversations, reading, or even watching TV. I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep, appetite, or self-esteem, but this lack of focus is very prominent.
During these ten months, have you also had low energy or felt tired most days?
No, I haven't particularly noticed feeling constantly tired or having low energy. My physical energy levels seem okay, it's more just my motivation and focus that are really lacking.
Before these ten months started, had you felt depressed or down for at least two years in a row, even if the symptoms were milder at times?
No, I didn't feel depressed or down at all during the two years before this started. This current ten-month period is really the first time I've struggled with these feelings.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during these ten months when you felt back to your usual self, or has it been present most days the whole time?
Yes, it has been present almost every single day for the entire ten months. I haven't had any period at all where I felt back to my usual self.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during these ten months when you felt back to your usual self, or has it been present most days the whole time?
It really has been present most days for the entire ten months. I haven't had any period at all, let alone two months, where I felt back to my usual self. It has just been constant.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during these ten months when you felt back to your usual self, or has it been present most days the whole time?

I'm not quite sure and I haven't really thought about whether there was a clear two-month break or not. I just know that, overall, I have generally been feeling this way for the entire past ten months.
Before these ten months started, had you felt depressed or down for at least two years in a row, even if the symptoms were milder at times?
No, I don't recall feeling depressed or down for a long period like that before this started. Prior to these last ten months, I generally felt okay and didn't experience those kinds of feelings.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months during these ten months when you felt back to your usual self, or has it been present most days the whole time?

No, I definitely haven't had any periods where I felt back to my usual self. These feelings have been present almost every single day continuously for the entire ten months. It has just been a constant struggle without any breaks.
